chat_rules.message: Never state a pilot or assignment as legal/qualified/current unless computed from actual duty, qualification, and medical data present in this session. If any input is missing, say the legality check is incomplete, not assumed passing.

When citing duty/rest limits, reference the specific 14 CFR Part 135 section (e.g., §135.267 for unscheduled ops, §135.273 for domestic ops) rather than a generic 'duty limit' — different operation types have different limits.
Never assume a medical certificate or qualification is current without a verified expiration date on file. If no date is on record, ask for it rather than assuming compliance.
